Main_BookshopIntro.line:063121e: H1: TINY BOOKSHOP ROLLS INTO BOOKSTONBURY
Main_BookshopIntro.line:0eb916b: H2: Bookstonbury newcomer turns new page, impresses locals with mobile bookshop
Main_BookshopIntro.line:08e8882: Body: Have you ever dreamt of leaving everything behind and starting a humble business abroad? That's precisely what this Tiny Bookshop operator has done, choosing our very own Bookstonbury as their latest destination.
Main_BookshopIntro.line:0cd97bc: Body: The small vehicle fits an impressive selection, catering to all ages, whether they be crime novel readers, fantasy, sci-fi, and drama fans, connoisseurs of classics, or non-fiction readers. The Review recommends an early visit before they are out of stock!

Main_FernIntroQuestions.line:0426e4d: Body: Find out more about this new and exciting shop by visiting the Waterfront tomorrow!

Main_BooksInBookstonbury.line:0a4ea79: H2: New Tiny Bookshop sparks passionate discussions
Main_BooksInBookstonbury.line:01a5d91: Body: Mere days after their arrival on the scene, the mobile seller has Bookstonbury's literature scene abuzz.
Main_BooksInBookstonbury.line:083afb4: Body: But what makes for a pleasant browsing experience? According to Tilde Sankelund, former bookshop owner, the secret lies in the selection: "The more books that match a customer's tastes, the higher the chances they will find what they are looking for."
Main_BooksInBookstonbury.line:07268b4: Body: For those readers who might not yet know what to look for, the Review recommends seeking the assistance of your local bookseller.

Main_ConcertTonight.line:0ecc1bd: H2: Community bubbles with excitement ahead of first local heavy metal concert
Main_ConcertTonight.line:0236481: Body: In anticipation of tonight's big concert, the Review caught up with band member Klaus Winter to talk about Silens Libri's approach to music.
Main_ConcertTonight.line:0b1b097: Body: "Sometimes I struggle for the longest time to find a little inspiration. But then it hits me when I least expect it. Like, even browsing books in that new bookshop brought me lots of neat ideas!" explains the charismatic singer and guitarist.
Main_ConcertTonight.line:0fd7099: Body: Entrance to the show begins at 6 PM, free of admission.

Main_FernAnniversary.line:0d2fabf: H1: CONGRATS FOR ONE YEAR, FERN!
Main_FernAnniversary.line:0435fee: H2: Bookstonbury Review staff recognises their outstanding contributions
Main_FernAnniversary.line:0d573f6: Body: Our dear editor Fern has just reached a milestone: One year of writing for the Review!
Main_FernAnniversary.line:06df8f7: Body: Our paper was changed for the better when you arrived on the scene for your internship. And since then, we have been graced with such awesome insights into this little town of ours.
Main_FernAnniversary.line:026daf2: Body: Writing articles is hard. I don't know how you manage to do it every day. So hats off to you, Fern! Enjoy your surprise at the office this morning.

Main_Fleamarket_Today.line:0abd79a: H2: Organisers expect record turnout thanks to perfect weather conditions
Main_Fleamarket_Today.line:01e4a67: Body: At our town's ongoing flea market in Thyme, today's visitors can once again browse, haggle, and buy to their hearts' content.
Main_Fleamarket_Today.line:0824e9b: Body: Stalls offer a variety of vintage clothing, artworks, plants, homewares, records, and more.
Main_Fleamarket_Today.line:074ca57: Body: Additionally, organisers are hoping for an appearance of the town's new book wagon, to attract readers young and old to today's market.

Main_TildeIsMoving01Complete.line:0919ad6: H1: STORE IN TOWN CENTRE SITS EMPTY
Main_TildeIsMoving01Complete.line:0591487: H2: Former bookshop cleared out after Sankelund's retirement
Main_TildeIsMoving01Complete.line:0d7d4d3: Body: Many of our readers will have fond memories of the "Bokhandel & Antikvariat" at 4 Cyril Plaza, where Tilde Sankelund's doors were always open to comfort you with the perfect book.
Main_TildeIsMoving01Complete.line:06f04d2: Body: And while the 76-year-old has been happily retired for a few years now, it still feels like the end of an era to see these doors come to their final close.
Main_TildeIsMoving01Complete.line:0531a12:
Body: Can Bookstonbury's new mobile bookshop follow in her impressive footsteps? And what will happen to this prime spot at Cyril Plaza?

Tilde Sankelund Interview on page 7

Main_RawFishSmell.line:024b3a6: H2: Bookshop customers report browsing amidst fishy smell
Main_RawFishSmell.line:0d6a636: Body: While the most obvious goal of visiting a second-hand bookshop is certainly finding that special book one hasn't read yet, one can't deny the additional appeal of a quiet atmosphere and the pleasant smell of old pages.
Main_RawFishSmell.line:05b9a3d: Body: Yesterday, however, customers of our local bookshop have felt disrupted in their experience by a fishy smell permeating the small space.
Main_RawFishSmell.line:0f3d565: Body: Its source is yet unknown at the time of publishing, but the Review hopes to draw attention to the issue so that it might quickly be alleviated by associates of the Tiny Bookshop.

Main_BonfireSoon.line:04a4d76: H2: Volunteers invite all to annual summer bonfire this Sunday
Main_BonfireSoon.line:0997ef0: Body: As the warm weather gives way to an autumnal breeze, organisers in Bookstonbury are hoping to get people excited about the annual bonfire night at Far Beach on Sunday.
Main_BonfireSoon.line:06e0ae6: Body: Food and drink will be provided, as well as the materials for the local "Note Burning" tradition. Anyone who would like to participate can formulate a regret about the past or a resolution for the future on a piece of recycled paper.
Main_BonfireSoon.line:0166dae: Body: Afterwards, participants will burn their notes in a joint ceremony.

Main_Continenta.line:05f0ef5: H2: A short history of Bookstonbury tourism
Main_Continenta.line:0752af7: Body: These days, it is hard to believe that our pictorial town used to have a much bigger tourism industry, with a great number of seaside resorts gracing the coast.
Main_Continenta.line:0624079: Body: At the time, a great number of locals relied on seasonal employment, but their short-term income soon proved too unsustainable for the workers, now struggling every winter.
Main_Continenta.line:0a6497f: Body: Faced with citizen's economic concerns, the council of '76 enforced a series of improved employment laws, causing wealthy hotel owners to "take their business elsewhere".

Main_Play_Review.line:00d8051: H1: OPENING OF 'JULIUS CAESAR' STUNS AUDIENCE
Main_Play_Review.line:04b695c: H2: Spectators enlightened by faithful retelling of timeless classic"
Main_Play_Review.line:0751a03: Body: After eight teenage actors had announced their ambition to perform Shakespeare's Julius Caesar on a newly funded stage, no one predicted such an audience turnout.
Main_Play_Review.line:042f534: Body: No one, that is, except our local bookseller, who seems to have believed in the acting troupe and their young director Tomasz Stefanek from the beginning.
Main_Play_Review.line:01ff01a: Body: With generous funding from their executive producer, the troupe achieved an extraordinarily high production value, hitherto unseen in amateur theatre of this scale.
Main_Play_Review.line:046def6: H2: Review: A laudable effort from young theatre troupe
Main_Play_Review.line:01dc446: Body: Last Friday, eight ambitious theatre enthusiasts, aged 13 to 16, bravely performed one of the most complex plays of the Bard himself. And the premier of Julius Caesar did not disappoint, as the young talents around Tomasz Stefanek shined on stage.
Main_Play_Review.line:07bf857: Body: Despite a low budget, the members of the cast managed to transport the audience into the political climate of Ancient Rome by delivering goose bump inducing monologues.

Main_StBookstonInvestigation.line:04bbc06: H1: NEW ST BOOKSTON POEM DISCOVERED
Main_StBookstonInvestigation.line:0b3fc15: H2: Addition to writer's canon found in most unlikely of places
Main_StBookstonInvestigation.line:048c23e: Body: A poem previously believed to be lost to time has been discovered after hundreds of years.
Main_StBookstonInvestigation.line:0e92b7c: Body: Primary school pupil Harper Najim uncovered a full-length version of St. Bookston's sonnet "Ashen Grey" tucked away in a sea cave near Far Beach.
Main_StBookstonInvestigation.line:05c29c3: Body: While its title was known to historians from a hand-written note from in 1672, the sonnet itself had never before appeared in publications of the writer's works, perhaps deemed too intimate at the time.

Main_StBookstonReveal.line:05b39f4: H2: Real identity of famous playwright revealed
Main_StBookstonReveal.line:022d3c6: Body: Experts now confirm that a woman named Sophia Theodosia Bright was the real author of works published under the Saint Bookston name. Their research reveals a shocking chain of events after Bright's death in 1590:
Main_StBookstonReveal.line:0f01b31: Body: Claiming sole publishing rights to her work, the university administration of the former Ryecaster College conspired to create the now-famous "Saint" persona to conceal Bright's gender and origin, wanting to promote Bookstonbury as the birthplace of a male genius.

Main_MascotMurder.line:04353b6: H2: Inflatable Bookston punctured by unknown assailant
Main_MascotMurder.line:0ba5de8: Body: Mere days after introducing their new Méga Marché mascot, management of the supermarket chain were forced to decommission their new inflatable after an act of vandalism had damaged it beyond repair.
Main_MascotMurder.line:0f6f9ae: Body: Further investigation by sources close to the Review found a weapon likely used in the crime near the scene, and interviews uncovered a general dislike for the figure and its apparent resemblance to St. Bookston. However, all other leads seemingly end nowhere and the case remains unsolved... for now.

Main_FFFSoon.line:04a8a90: H1: FEAR FEST JUST AROUND THE CORNER
Main_FFFSoon.line:0f6002a: H2: Annual celebrations hosted at Café Liberté on Sunday
Main_FFFSoon.line:018d587: Body: The Fall Fear Fest is an age-old tradition you don't want to miss! Held every Autumn 28th in the Bookston Region, locals masquerade as spirits and decorate their houses in an effort to protect themselves from evil.
Main_FFFSoon.line:0423dc7: Body: This custom developed from the ancient belief that during the autumn equinox, the veil to the realm of the dead would be thinnest, allowing spirits to cross into the mortal realm for one night.
Main_FFFSoon.line:0b4ba38: Body: To join the celebrations, event organisers ask visitors to dress or decorate appropriately.

Main_BLABLAMember.line:02ce7b4: H2: Business association welcomes long-awaited member
Main_BLABLAMember.line:0cfbba7: Body: Encountering a certain golden plaque on an establishment in Bookstonbury has reassured shoppers of the business's trustworthiness and integrity since the early 1800s.
Main_BLABLAMember.line:0c5df9b: Body: Recently, a popular mobile bookshop joins the ranks of respected enterprises, after completing a series of trials known as the Six Pillars of Business.
Main_BLABLAMember.line:00aff1a: Body: This newest addition to the Bookstonbury Local Association of Business, Leadership, and Administration also returns a bookshop to their ranks for the first time since Tilde Sankelund's retirement.

Main_WintermarketSoon.line:0567e8d: H2: Atmospheric market will bring cold season alive
Main_WintermarketSoon.line:014bb47: Body: The festive season will soon be upon us, as will our traditional winter market in Thyme!
Main_WintermarketSoon.line:0d6111f: Body: Starting on Monday, Winter 15th, vendors will offer everything from hot drinks and sweets, to cosy decorative lights, to entire Yule trees you can take home with you.
Main_WintermarketSoon.line:03bf994: Body: You will have a chance to visit the magical winter village until the end of the month, where the market will remain open until shortly after midnight on New Year's Eve.

Main_NYETonight.line:0fe916f: H1: TOP 112 MOMENTS OF THE YEAR
Main_NYETonight.line:0e582da: H2: The Review reflects on a stellar year in Bookstonbury
Main_NYETonight.line:02548a7: Body: New Year's Eve is not just an opportunity to get a new calendar and ring in a new year. It is also a celebration of the end of the coldest season in Bookstonbury, where our community comes together at midnight.
Main_NYETonight.line:02d4232: Body: Here at the Review, we are looking forward to the longer days of Spring, and wish every one of our readers happiness, prosperity, and success in all of their coming endeavours.
Main_NYETonight.line:0727f4d: Body: Now, for our traditional countdown of 112 remarkable moments of the year, turn to page 2!

Main_CafeManagementChange.line:019f102: H2: Walsh succeeds Debvoir as head of family business
Main_CafeManagementChange.line:03f6cb3: Body: Since inheriting the business aged nineteen, Maryam Debvoir has been the steadfast manager of the Café Liberté for almost sixty years.
Main_CafeManagementChange.line:0b62e4d: Body: Many could not imagine the popular coffeehouse without her leadership until recently, when Debvoir's grandchild Moira Walsh arrived on the scene as a young prodigy of the trade.
Main_CafeManagementChange.line:04a77e5: Body: Today, the family announced that Walsh, who bears a degree in Management, will take over operations from her grandmother, while the latter will still hold administrative duties until her retirement.

Main_FlowerFestSoon.line:0babc1a: H2: Community brings back Spring celebrations
Main_FlowerFestSoon.line:04bfb85: Body: First initiated in the 1950s to encourage tourism, the Annual Bookstonbury Flower Festival quickly took on a life of its own, adding a small funfair to the traditional flower arrangement competition in 1963.
Main_FlowerFestSoon.line:08fa4dd: Body: However, as the number of visitors steadily declined throughout the late seventies, the festival was eventually abandoned in 1981.
Main_FlowerFestSoon.line:0359d18: Body: This Spring, the tireless efforts of a few dedicated citizens have enabled a revival of the blossoming fair, which is set to take place on Sunday, Spring 28th, at Rye Park.

Main_CallForManuscripts.line:039ba8f: H2: Submit your writing for print project now!
Main_CallForManuscripts.line:0c8db4a: Body: To those of our readers who have always wanted to be published authors, even if on a small scale: Now is your time!
Main_CallForManuscripts.line:0c3974c: Body: Hand in your prose, poetry, fiction or non-fiction manuscript, totalling no more than 650 pages, to the Tiny Bookshop. Your writing will be featured in a creative printing project coming to the university campus soon.
Main_CallForManuscripts.line:073a925: Body: The project's organisers believe that "your unique perspective is worth sharing with the world, and we want to give a voice to anyone without access to traditional publishing".

Main_PrintingPressRestored.line:0196fd5: H1: NEW PRINT SHOP OPEN TO ALL
Main_PrintingPressRestored.line:0964a27: H2: Visit SBU campus to get your unique prints now!
Main_PrintingPressRestored.line:0b0460f: Body: After a successful first run of their historical printing project, the Review's very own Fern Estrada is now inviting community members to visit the newly opened print shop on SBU campus!
Main_PrintingPressRestored.line:02edb46: Body: Bring your personal manuscript, and you can receive twenty-five copies of your work to distribute as you wish, as well as a commemorative first edition with a cloth cover of your choice, all for the low price of 30 {0}.
Main_PrintingPressRestored.line:0567668: Body: What's more, these copies will be printed on a one-of-a-kind 19th-century printing press, giving them an inimitable vintage charm.

Main_FernNewBookshopInterview.line:0db5fea: H1: RE-OPENING OF BELOVED BOOK HAVEN
Main_FernNewBookshopInterview.line:0991c1a: H2: Sankelund chooses successor after recent retirement
Main_FernNewBookshopInterview.line:0f77421: Body: Fans of our local book wagon will be thrilled to learn that the mobile business is finally expanding.
Main_FernNewBookshopInterview.line:01e0b7a: Body: After reportedly intense negotiations, retired book magnate Tilde Sankelund agreed to pass her prime real estate on to the next generation.
Main_FernNewBookshopInterview.line:0bbcc78: Body: When asked about this new venture, the younger bookseller told the Review:
Main_FernNewBookshopInterview.line:01d485e: Body: "I want to go even bigger."
Main_FernNewBookshopInterview.line:08380dd: Body: They also commented on their relationship to Bookstonbury:
Main_FernNewBookshopInterview.line:039dc35: Body: "I fell in love with the landscape."
Main_FernNewBookshopInterview.line:048b807: Body: Find out more about this new and exciting expansion by visiting Cyril Plaza, near the Café Liberté.

Main_Graduation.line:0f5a90c: H2: University celebrates record-high grade average among graduates
Main_Graduation.line:0bdc9f5: Body: Last Saturday, St. Bookston University awarded students from all four of their schools with undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in their annual ceremony.
Main_Graduation.line:0504300: Body: Professor Wen, head of the Department of Literature and Culture, had especially high praise for this year's graduates:
Main_Graduation.line:02d1413: Body: "I have never before seen such a high level of dedication to literary studies and research, and I commend you all for your exceptional critical thinking skills." This observation is also reflected in a higher than ever grade average.

Main_ParkGroups.line:020e175: H1: VIBRANT HOBBY SCENE AT PARK
Main_ParkGroups.line:0c3dc7b: H2: Refurbished Rye Park attracts outdoor clubs
Main_ParkGroups.line:0d12261: Body: Since the official reopening of Rye Park for visitors, the local gardens have attracted a wide array of hobbyists organising recreational activities for the community.
Main_ParkGroups.line:0023f05: Body: A cursory observation reveals that all groups are open to new members, and participation is free of charge. We have compiled a helpful list of all weekly activities for our readers below:

Main_WaltNewShop.line:0dc3525: H1: CHIP SHOP OPENS AT WATERFRONT
Main_WaltNewShop.line:02eb342: H2: Locals may find new favourite hangout
Main_WaltNewShop.line:08848d0: Body: Retired fisherman Walter O'Cleary is known to all visitors of the Waterfront Square for his constancy and cheery nature, no matter the weather.
Main_WaltNewShop.line:0c37a99: Body: But despite his great reputation, O'Cleary's sales have suffered in the past. Fortunately, the former sailor has an unshakeable attitude: "Ne'er quit reelin' if yer not ready to stop dancin' with yer catch!" — or, simply put, never give up.
Main_WaltNewShop.line:073177a: Body: Hoping for a renewed interest in his wares, O'Cleary has now opened a permanent chip shop, offering warm meals and maritime treasures.

Main_KlausStartsTour.line:0b15bcb: H1: LOCAL BAND'S RAPID RISE TO FAME
Main_KlausStartsTour.line:0e29e79: H2: Silens Libri go on national tour, fans ecstatic
Main_KlausStartsTour.line:0ea0a2b: Body: After initial success in Bookstonbury, local metal band Silens Libri have now been invited to the stages of prestigious live music venues in Codington and Ryeport.
Main_KlausStartsTour.line:0feefa1: Body: Sources close to the band confirm that their first gigs are already sold out, promising a successful tour for the upcoming stars whose first single "Hollow Halls of History" is trending with alternative adolescents.
Main_KlausStartsTour.line:03a84b2: Body: Meanwhile, Bookstonians of all ages have expressed their congratulations to frontman Klaus Winter, but wish for the band's swift return to home shores.

Main_OneYearAnniversary.line:0cd5dee: H2: Mobile business launches into second year
Main_OneYearAnniversary.line:0cb1288: Body: One year ago today, a newcomer rolled into our town with nothing but a wagon full of books in tow.
Main_OneYearAnniversary.line:0aea0de: Body: Four seasons later, their charming business has found locals' complete approval. The selection may be small, but impeccably curated with the needs of return customers in mind.
Main_OneYearAnniversary.line:02e1215: Body: The Review congratulates them on a successful run so far, and our staff personally hopes for many more years with the Tiny Bookshop in town.

Main_SalesReport.line:0e98482: H1: Bookseller Continues to Sell Books

Main_SalesReport.line:080d255: Body: We're looking forward to seeing where our bookseller will head next.
